title: IVG Pro Salts Mr Blue 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Mr Blue 10ml E-Liquid delivers a wonderfully complex and deeply refreshing fruit experience. The profile starts with a rich, dark base of juicy Mixed Berries, intertwined with the syrupy sweetness of ripe Grapes. As the dense fruit notes settle, a distinct and breezy layer of cooling Menthol emerges on the exhale, providing a sharp contrast that makes this recipe highly satisfying and multi-dimensional. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the complex dark fruits of Mr Blue, vapers can explore other standout options such as the crisp Juicy Apple or the vibrant confectionery notes of Raspberry Blast, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
